messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "alcohol may increase risk of liver damage"
set: ["alcohol may increase risk of liver damage", "increased risk of liver damage", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "may increase risk of low birth weight", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth", "may increase risk of heavy bleeding after delivery", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage", "uncontrolled asthma may increase risk of premature birth", "long term use may increase risk of broken bone", "osteoporosis risk increase", "drugs that increase risk of bleeding", "may increase risk of neural tube defects in early pregnancy", "combinations can increase risk of serotonin syndrome"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
